notes: The supplied object *it* of *he maketh it not to grow* was folded into `בְּרִית` under rule 25's resumption sentences, while 2SA.23.16 marks the identical construction — a supplied object pronoun in a clause whose Hebrew writes no object morpheme — `added` under rule 44, with `מַיִם` standing written in that verse just as `בְּרִית` stands written here. Rule 44's supplied-object clause is explicit and on point, so t037 becomes its own `added` unit. The subject *it* of *For it is all my salvation* stays with `בְּרִית`: that clause writes no subject word at all, which is rule 25's own case, so only one of the two pronouns moves.
